STEP 1 - Scene: This is a plated restaurant dish. It has a breaded or crusted stuffed chicken roulade, sliced, with mushrooms inside. Beside it is a small salad of greens topped with quinoa or crumbs, mushrooms and a roasted carrot, plus a small piece of corn on the cob.

STEP 2 - Vessel: The dish sits on a square white plate about 27 cm per side, giving an area of roughly 27 × 27 = 730 cm². Treating it as a ~28 cm round equivalent gives ~615 cm². I'll use ~700 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Stuffed chicken roulade with crust
- Mushroom stuffing
- Leafy greens (spinach or kale)
- Quinoa/crumb topping
- Roasted carrot
- Sautéed mushrooms
- Corn cob piece
- Some oil

STEP 4 - Area (food covers about 20% of the plate in total):

| Item | Share of plate | Area |
|---|---|---|
| Chicken roulade | ~9% | 63 cm² |
| Greens | ~6% | 42 cm² |
| Quinoa/mushrooms | ~2% | 14 cm² |
| Carrot | ~1% | 7 cm² |
| Corn | ~1.5% | 10 cm² |

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Chicken: 63 cm² × 3 cm = 189 ml
- Greens: 42 cm² × 2 cm = 84 ml
- Quinoa/mushrooms: 14 cm² × 1.5 cm = 21 ml
- Carrot: 7 cm² × 1.5 cm = 10 ml
- Corn: 10 cm² × 2.5 cm = 25 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Chicken: 189 ml × 0.85 ≈ 160 g
- Greens: 84 ml × 0.2 ≈ 17 g
- Quinoa/mushrooms: 21 ml × 0.8 ≈ 17 g
- Carrot: 10 ml × 0.7 ≈ 7 g
- Corn: 25 ml × 0.6 ≈ 15 g
- Oil: ~6 g

STEP 7 - Energy:

| Item | Grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Breaded stuffed chicken | 160 | 200 | 320 |
| Greens | 17 | 30 | 5 |
| Quinoa/mushroom | 17 | 110 | 19 |
| Carrot | 7 | 50 | 4 |
| Corn | 15 | 96 | 14 |
| Oil | 6 | 884 | 53 |

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The total is about 222 g and 415 kcal. That is plausible for a modest restaurant portion.
